about:
Amerifab Corporation, a custom sheet metal fabricator, was founded in 1976 in Lodi, New Jersey. The company has operated as a job shop serving the region for nearly five decades, building a reputation for quality and service across a range of metalworking projects.

From its Lodi facility, the shop offers a broad range of capabilities including shearing and bending up to 12 feet, CNC punching, rolling, and welding (TIG, MIG, and stick). Secondary services cover grinding and polishing, sanitary finishing, and patina finishes. Work is performed on materials such as stainless steel, aluminum, carbon steel, galvanized steel, brass, bronze, copper, and Muntz metal. The company handles prototype, small-quantity, and production runs.

Amerifab serves customers in architectural, industrial, pharmaceutical, machinery builder, and food industries. Its client base includes firms requiring custom metal fabrications for equipment, sanitary systems, and architectural elements.

The company emphasizes quality and service with quick turnarounds as its defining differentiators, positioning itself as a responsive job shop for diverse metal fabrication needs.
